command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
SHA=d894abc44d5ef6800ff2418ae2bfaa717fd76688
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git switch --detach "$SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-cover-120-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pytest -q backend/app/tests/services/test_admin_services.py backend/app/tests/services/test_admin_photo_workflows.py
git diff --check 14ff20515041a23a1cf9aa509d4f079c6a62a1f7 "$SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
printf 'verified_sha=%s\n' "$SHA"
trap - EXIT
rm -rf "$VENV"
